sources.label: retained original
sources.qualification: The source has visible cracks, but the model retry repeats east-like crack placement in west and introduces steep coloured crack facets (raw 99th tilt53–68degrees). Its geometric packing guard passes, which does not certify feature correspondence. Dark crack-palette candidates also overlap isolated soil marks and outer edges and omit substantial visible line segments, so a semantic groove mask is ambiguous. Retain the original macro normals; fine crack receiving relief remains unresolved.
